newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE May white sugar expires weaker, volume heavy.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE May white sugar expires weaker, volume heavy.

text.p: London's May white sugar contract clawed back some of its lost ground at close of business on Tuesday, the last session of its trading life, but still ended weaker on the day.
May closed at $305.00, down $1.50, after an afternoon of see-saw trading as players scrambled to bale out of the position before it went off the board.
LIFFE will issue details of physical deliveries against the May contract on Wednesday morning.
Traders have estimated amounts of between two and 10 cargoes, although the most recent calculations based on uncovered positions suggested around five cargoes.
The second-month August contract closed at $308.40, down 50 cents. Overall volume amounted to a hefty 4,257 lots, booated by against actuals and switch trades.

Light trade and commission house buying dragged May off its session low of $302.60 but the nearby May/August spread remained at a discount through most of the day while August/October and other spreads were at premiums.
